# 1. Hexabiblos of Constantine Harmenopoulos
oe_mst.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_mst.1.t
	desc = oe_mst.1.d
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v200_academy_tutorial_hall.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	option = {
		name = oe_mst.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		add_gold = -120
		create_character = {
			artist = oe_art_imperial_jurist
			artist_skill = 0.85
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			min_age = 28
			max_age = 46
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:thessaloniki }
			location:thessaloniki = {
				create_art = {
					quality = 94
					type = work_of_art_type:oe_woa_imperial_law_code
					key = oe_art_hexabiblos_1345
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				create_art = {
					quality = 94
					type = work_of_art_type:oe_woa_imperial_law_code
					key = oe_art_hexabiblos_1345
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mst_golden_atelier_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 12

	}

	option = {

# 13. Cross-Border Master Artist Patronage Selection (oe_mst_patronize_master)
oe_mst.13 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_mst.13.t
	desc = oe_mst.13.d
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_v135_masterpiece_atelier.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	# Option A: Law Codifier or East Asian Literati Polymath
	option = {
		name = oe_mst.13.a
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					court_language.language_family ?= language_family:chinese_language_family
					court_language = language:korean_language
					court_language = language:vietnamese_language
					owns = location:wuxian
					owns = location:shangyuan
					owns = location:dadu
					owns = location:kaesong
					owns = location:namgyeong
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_literati_polymath
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_imperial_jurist
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 6
	}

	# Option B: Regional Court Atelier Master (Suiboku / Kilnmaster / Mughal Naturalist / Persian Miniaturist)
	option = {
		name = oe_mst.13.b
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					court_language = language:japanese_language
					AND = {
						exists = religion
						religion = religion:shinto
					}
					owns = location:kyoto
					owns = location:osaka
					owns = location:toshima_kanto
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_ukiyo_ink_master
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					owns = location:fuliang
					owns = location:shangyuan
					owns = location:hangzhou
					court_language.language_family ?= language_family:chinese_language_family
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_imperial_kilnmaster
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					owns = location:delhi
					owns = location:agra
					owns = location:vijayanagar
					capital ?= { continent = continent:asia region = region:hindustan_region }
					capital ?= { continent = continent:asia region = region:deccan_region }
					capital ?= { continent = continent:asia region = region:bengal_region }
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_mughal_atelier_master
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_persian_miniaturist
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 6
	}

	# Option C: Precision Horologist or Grand Cartographer & Master Builder
	option = {
		name = oe_mst.13.c
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					owns = location:venice
					owns = location:genoa
					owns = location:amsterdam
					owns = location:antwerp
					AND = {
						has_advance = university_advance
						capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
					}
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_murano_horologist
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_character = {
				artist = oe_art_grand_cartographer
				artist_skill = 0.85
				estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
				min_age = 28
				max_age = 46
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 6
	}
}

# 14. Masterpiece Restitution Pride & Treasury Vigilance (soft-linked with W2 oe_pt_restitute_masterpieces)
oe_mst.14 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_mst.14.t
	desc = oe_mst.14.d
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_v135_masterpiece_atelier.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	option = {
		name = oe_mst.14.a
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mst_restituted_pride_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 10
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_mst.14.b
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_mst_stolen_art_resolve_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_quality < 98 } }
			ordered_work_of_art_in_country = {
				limit = { art_quality < 98 }
				order_by = art_quality
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				change_art_quality = 3
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 6
	}
}
